description.purpose: Version 1 was a sealed agent with its own affinity, its own access and fixed grants; that line is frozen as the max-agent. Version 2 is the agent of a colony: affinity, access and the llm-registry belong to the colony and reach the agent over contract lanes its embedder draws, so the agent keeps no record of people and no key of its own. A plain agent in hive form, the way agents are commonly built: a system prompt and messages, native tool calling, results as `tool_result`, a loop until the model stops (capped at `max_iter` 16). Its own tools come from a tools hive (bash, file, edit, web_fetch, web_search, weather); the caller adds client tools per turn, which leave the hive as `calls` and come back as `tool_result` inside the same turn. A curator, a memory hive and the sidecar work as in talky/cogny. Sealed: its identity arrives by pack (`in_pack`), the brief about a counterpart on `brief`/`in_briefing`, its writes leave on `affinity_propose`, and every model cell asks the colony's access on `credential_request` under the grant it was born with (`override_params`). Since 1.0.1 (#1292) the template pins `memory-hive@3.16.6`; it is the third digit. Since 1.1.0 (#1292) the template carries this change and pins `collector@5.4.0`; it is the second digit. Since 1.1.1 (#1294) the template carries this change and pins `access@2.6.2`, `curator@1.15.1`, `memory-hive@3.16.7` and `tools@1.6.2`; it is the third digit. Since 1.1.2 (#1298) the template pins `curator@1.15.2` and `memory-hive@3.16.8`; it is the third digit. Since 1.1.3 (#1300) the template carries this change and pins `curator@1.15.3` and `memory-hive@3.16.9`; it is the third digit. Since 1.1.4 (#1303) the template pins `curator@1.16.0` and `memory-hive@3.16.10`; it is the third digit. Since 2.0.0 (#1307) the template carries this change; it is the first digit. Since 2.1.0 (#1311) the template carries this change; it is the second digit. Since 2.1.1 (#1315) the template carries this change and pins `memory-hive@3.18.0`; it is the third digit. Since 2.1.2 (#1320) the template pins `memory-hive@3.18.1`; it is the third digit. Since 2.2.0 (#1321) the template carries this change and pins `collector@5.6.0`; it is the second digit. Since 2.2.1 (#1332) the template pins `memory-hive@3.19.1`; it is the third digit. Since 2.2.2 (#1333) the template pins `curator@1.16.2` and `memory-hive@3.19.2`; it is the third digit. Since 2.2.3 (#1335) the template pins `curator@1.16.3` and `memory-hive@3.19.3`; it is the third digit. Since 2.2.4 (#1337) the template pins `curator@1.16.4` and `memory-hive@3.19.4`; it is the third digit. description.use_when: One instance per agent: as the brain of a figure in a world, as a worker behind any caller that speaks the turn door, or alone.
description.not_in_scope: No world, no game day, no phone, no companion, no member, no build pair, no orga hive: a caller that needs one wraps the agent and speaks its turn door.
examples: turn -> brain -> weather -> file -> brain -> answer (three model calls, one answer)
turn with tools[] -> brain calls a client tool -> calls on the rim -> tool_result -> the same turn goes on -> answer
